scripts.build: pnpm -C packages/tui run build && pnpm -C packages/ai run build && pnpm -C packages/agent run build && pnpm -C packages/coding-agent run build && pnpm -C packages/mom run build && pnpm -C packages/web-ui run build && pnpm -C packages/pods run build
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "ai,agent,coding-agent,mom,web-ui,tui" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,red,white,green,magenta" "pnpm -C packages/ai run dev" "pnpm -C packages/agent run dev" "pnpm -C packages/coding-agent run dev" "pnpm -C packages/mom run dev" "pnpm -C packages/web-ui run dev" "pnpm -C packages/tui run dev"
scripts.dev:tsc: concurrently --names "ai,web-ui" --prefix-colors "cyan,green" "pnpm -C packages/ai run dev:tsc" "pnpm -C packages/web-ui run dev:tsc"
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && tsgo --noEmit && pnpm -C packages/web-ui run check
scripts.version:patch: pnpm version patch --workspaces --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules package-lock.json && pnpm install
scripts.version:minor: pnpm version minor --workspaces --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules package-lock.json && pnpm install
scripts.version:major: pnpm version major --workspaces --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules package-lock.json && pnpm install
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build && pnpm run check
scripts.publish: pnpm run prepublishOnly && pnpm -r publish --access public
scripts.publish:dry: pnpm run prepublishOnly && pnpm -r publish --access public --dry-run
